description: Na₄Ce(As₂O₇)₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/ncc space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.69 Å. Ce is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.38 Å) and four longer (2.41 Å) Ce-O bond lengths. As is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing AsO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.69-1.83 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three equivalent Na and one As atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent As atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Ce, and one As atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Ce and one As atom.
